turns.question: What share of the orders placed in September 2026 were returned?
turns.answer: About 1.67 % of the orders placed from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 were returned (return rate 0.0167). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
